recipe.name: Caveman T-Bones with Bell Pepper Hash
directions: Build a charcoal fire and rake the coals into an even layer. (Leave the front third of your grill coal-free.) When the coals glow orange, fan them with a newspaper to blow off any loose ash.

Generously, and I mean generously, season the steaks on both sides with salt and cracked pepper. Place the steaks directly on the embers about 2 inches apart. Grill until cooked to taste, about 4 minutes per side for medium-rare, turning with tongs. Move the steaks after 2 minutes on each side so they cook evenly.

Using tongs, lift the steaks out of the fire, shaking each to dislodge any clinging embers. Using a basting brush, brush off any loose ash and arrange the steaks on a platter or plates. Let the steaks rest, loosely tented with aluminum foil, while you make the hash.

Make the pepper pan-roast: Heat the olive oil in a cast-iron skillet directly on the embers on the side burner of a gas grill or on the stove. When the oil is hot, add the peppers, garlic, and parsley. Cook over high heat until the peppers and garlic begin to brown, 2 minutes. Immediately pour over the steaks and serve at once.

ingredients.name: T-bone Steaks
ingredients.notes: each 12 to 16 ounces and 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 inches thick

ingredients.name: Coarse Salt (kosher or Sea) and Coarsely Cracked Black Peppercorns
